cells: C1
EWMA gate over input magnitudes with recency half-life 8 ticks; encodes in a 64-d rotate-k frame, k=3.
Reads C2 and C3; attenuates C3 by recency; writes into C7 and C9; shares its basis frame with C5.
C2
Magnitude gate with hard threshold 0.5 and hysteresis 0.05; encodes in raw token basis.
Fed by the token stream; passes only strong edges to C1 and C4; isolated from C7.
C3
Variance gate, per-channel z-score clipping at 2.5; encodes in a frequency basis (FFT bins 0..31).
Tap on C2's output; forwards anomalies to C1 only; subscribes to C6's drift channel.
C4
Recency gate with exponential forgetting 0.9; encodes in a learned 128-d residual basis.
Consumes C2's edges and C9's rollups; suppresses stale inputs; feeds C10 and the audit sink.
C5
Linear projection, orthonormal 64x64 Hadamard-like basis, no gating.
Pure junction: relays C1's frame to C8 and C12 unchanged; no filtering of its own.
C6
Drift gate: slope estimator over 32-tick window; encodes delta in a compact 16-d basis.
Watches C4's audit stream; broadcasts drift deltas to C3 and C11; no direct payload path.
C7
Softmax gate over input scores, temperature 0.7; encodes in the shared residual basis.
Aggregates C1 and C8; routes the argmax to C12; backs off to C5's frame on tie.
C8
Dampening gate, per-edge gain 0.3; encodes in rotate-k frame, k=7.
Sits between C5's relay and C7's aggregation; damps everything it forwards to C9.
C9
Threshold gate at 0.8 with single-sample latch; encodes in raw token basis.
Collects C1 and C8; latches first crossing; alerts C4 and the audit sink.
Gain gate with saturating tanh; encodes in a 128-d learned basis shared with C4.
Only consumer of C4's forward path; mirrors its output to C12 for cross-check.
Band-stop filter gate, notch at bin 7; encodes in frequency basis (FFT bins 0..31).
Intercepts C6's drift channel; removes the 7-bin oscillation; forwards cleaned drift to C12.
Consensus gate: weighted vote of inputs, weights from reliability history; raw token basis out.
Terminal collector: C7 argmax, C10 mirror, C11 cleaned drift; emits the cell's final verdict.
